name: Citizenship by Descent (Birth)

qualifying_event.description: A child born with at least one Lithuanian-citizen parent acquires Lithuanian citizenship, per Article 14 of the Law on Citizenship.
qualifying_event.evidence_hint: Birth certificate; proof of parent's Lithuanian citizenship at time of birth.

requirements.blocker_text: At least one parent must be a Lithuanian citizen at the time of the child's birth, per Article 14 of the Law on Citizenship.

evidence_required.document: Proof of parent's Lithuanian citizenship at time of birth

sources.title: e-Seimas (Lithuania's official legislative database) -- Law on Citizenship, Article 14 (acquisition of citizenship by birth)
